Hello, I'm Dr. Agent. To start, can you describe how the swelling and pain in your right ring finger began, and have you noticed any recent injury or trauma to that area?
Klaus Mueller

The pain and swelling started two days ago while I was playing football. My finger got caught in another player's jersey, and he pulled away forcefully, which really hurt right then. Since that moment, it's been getting worse.
Maria Lopez

Did the swelling start suddenly or gradually, and are there any signs of redness, warmth, or pus that might suggest an infection? Also, do you have any history of arthritis, gout, or recent bites from insects or animals?
Klaus Mueller

The swelling started right after the injury and has been getting progressively worse since then. I haven't noticed any redness, warmth, or pus, and I don't have a history of arthritis, gout, or any insect or animal bites.
Maria Lopez

You mentioned the swelling is progressive; could you clarify if the pain is constant or throbbing, and does it worsen at night or with movement? Additionally, have you experienced similar episodes in other joints, or do you have a family history of autoimmune conditions or gout?
Klaus Mueller
The pain is constant and throbs more when I try to move my finger or make a fist. I haven't had similar episodes in other joints, and there is no family history of autoimmune conditions or gout.
Maria Lopez

Do you have any history of diabetes or peripheral vascular disease, and have you noticed any numbness, tingling, or color changes in the finger? Also, does the pain limit your ability to bend the finger fully, and have you tried any over-the-counter pain relievers or ice with any effect?
Klaus Mueller

No, I don't have diabetes or vascular disease, and I haven't felt any numbness or tingling in the finger. The pain definitely stops me from bending it fully; I can't curl my ring finger down to make a tight fist. I did try some ice, but it hasn't really helped much with the swelling or the inability to move it.
